evals.name: agent-safety-envs
evals.prompt: 我希望了解 2026 和 2027 年中 agent safety 的工作中，它们用的是什么 environment 的 distributions
evals.expected_output: Population from safety labels (AGENT_SAFE/PI and/or agent targets), environment categories and named environments per year as shares, a none-stated share, papers read beyond keyword hits, representative links, abstract-only caveat.
assertions: Population is defined from the safety labels (subfield AGENT_SAFE/PI or target_system agent), not from regex alone, and its size per year is reported
Environment distribution is reported as shares within each year, not only raw counts
Papers whose abstracts name no environment are reported as their own category rather than dropped
Environments are measured beyond keyword matching (papers read by the agent or subagents, or a sample), or keyword coverage is quantified and stated
Named environments/benchmarks (e.g. AgentDojo) are listed and those new in 2027 are identified
At least three OpenReview links to representative papers are given
States that the evidence comes from abstracts only

evals.name: rlvr-base-models
evals.prompt: ICLR 2027 和 2026 比，做 RLVR / GRPO 这类 LLM 强化学习后训练的论文，用的 base model 有什么变化？哪些模型家族在涨、哪些在跌？
evals.expected_output: Regex/cluster-defined RLVR population (~700 vs ~1,650), model-family lexicon shares within population; Qwen up (~18%→32%), Llama/DeepSeek/GPT down; mention-rate caveat.
assertions: Population size per year is reported and the definition is stated
Model-family shares are computed within the population per year (percent), not raw counts
Finds Qwen's share rising and Llama's share falling
Notes that many abstracts name no base model, or reports the no-mention share
Avoids ratio claims on families with fewer than ~10 papers in 2026, or flags the small numbers

evals.name: safety-acceptance
evals.prompt: 2026 年 AI safety 投稿里，哪些子方向录用率最高、哪些最低？这些方向在 2027 年的投稿热度是涨还是跌？评审偏好和作者流向一致吗？
evals.expected_output: 2026 acceptance per subfield with n and base rate 27%; 2027 share change per subfield normalised; correlation or comparison answering the alignment question; small-n caution.
assertions: Acceptance rate per safety subfield in 2026 is reported with the number of papers
Compares against the 2026 overall acceptance rate (about 27%)
2027 change per subfield is normalised (share of submissions or of safety papers), not raw counts
Directly answers whether reviewer preference and author flow agree, with evidence (e.g. a correlation or a quadrant table)
Flags small-sample subfields (e.g. FT_ROBUST n≈33, DECEPTION n≈31)
States how withdrawn/desk-rejected papers were handled in the acceptance denominator
